comment: I took a Physics course with Dr. Barti and I enjoyed the class. The course had lot of tough labs suitable for advanced physics classes. But Dr. Barti was very helpful in making us understand the topic.

Prof. Siva is very knowledgeable. I was initially afraid of taking the Physics course since I have not taken any Physics courses in High School. But her lecturers were well balanced that makes everyone in the class thrive. She will give you lot of homework and quizzes, but will make sure you learn material.

Dr. Siva is an amazing professor. One of the best I have taken on campus. She will make you work and 'earn' your grade. She is very clear in explaining the concept and is always willing to help outside the classroom.
